python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = "2026-11-20"
paths = [
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl",
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl",
]
for p in paths:
  print(f"\n=== {p} ===")
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    print("MISSING"); continue
  n=0
  with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        continue
      # find date-ish fields
      ts = o.get("ts") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("time") or o.get("received_at") or ""
      text = json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False)
      if day not in str(ts) and day not in text[:500]:
        # also check nested
        if day not in text:
          continue
      src = o.get("source") or o.get("kind") or o.get("from") or ""
      bus = o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or o.get("reply_to_bus_id")
      summary = (o.get("text") or o.get("summary") or o.get("prompt") or o.get("body") or "")[:200]
      print(f"- src={src} bus={bus} ts={ts} :: {summary}")
      n+=1
      if n>=40: print("...(cap 40)"); break
  if n==0: print("(no rows for day)")
PY

find "/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts" -name "*.jsonl" -mtime -1 2>/dev/null | head -30

# Summarize today's transcripts (user/assistant first messages)
for d in 1257bfd1-3af0-4086-ad93-0494e2e6dbc2 d787dd38-1270-47eb-875e-4583ff4ba5b1 5669d3f6-6aff-40f1-8b49-5fce4616a17b; do
  f="/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts/$d/$d.jsonl"
  echo "===== $d ====="
  python3 - <<PY
import json
path="$f"
users=[]; assists=[]
with open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as fh:
  for i,line in enumerate(fh):
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    role=o.get('role') or o.get('type') or ''
    # nested message shapes
    msg=o.get('message') or o
    content=msg.get('content') if isinstance(msg,dict) else None
    text=''
    if isinstance(content,str): text=content
    elif isinstance(content,list):
      parts=[]
      for c in content:
        if isinstance(c,dict) and c.get('type') in ('text','input_text'): parts.append(c.get('text') or '')
        elif isinstance(c,str): parts.append(c)
      text='\n'.join(parts)
    elif isinstance(msg,dict):
      text=str(msg.get('text') or msg.get('content') or '')[:500]
    text=(text or '')[:300].replace('\n',' ')
    r=(role or msg.get('role') if isinstance(msg,dict) else '') or o.get('type','')
    if 'user' in str(r).lower() or o.get('type')=='user':
      users.append(text)
    elif 'assistant' in str(r).lower() or o.get('type')=='assistant':
      assists.append(text)
print('users',len(users),'assists',len(assists))
for u in users[:5]:
  print('U:', u[:220])
print('--- last assist ---')
if assists: print(assists[-1][:250])
PY
done
